from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")

import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt
import pandas as pd
from dateutil.easter import easter
from matplotlib.axes import Axes
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor

TIMESTAMP_COLUMN = "utc_timestamp"
LOAD_COLUMN = "DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency"
FORECAST_START = pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC")
FORECAST_HOURS = 168
FORECAST_END = FORECAST_START + pd.Timedelta(hours=FORECAST_HOURS)
FORECAST_LAST = FORECAST_END - pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
FORECAST_DATE_LABEL = (
    f"{FORECAST_START.day}-{FORECAST_LAST.day} {FORECAST_START.strftime('%B %Y')}"
)
OUTPUT_STEM = (
    f"german_load_forecast_{FORECAST_START.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
    f"_to_{FORECAST_LAST.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
)
WEEKLY_LAGS = (168, 336, 504, 672)
MIN_TRAINING_HISTORY_HOURS = 840
VALIDATION_STARTS = (
    pd.Timestamp("2017-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
    pd.Timestamp("2018-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
    pd.Timestamp("2019-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
)
REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS = (*VALIDATION_STARTS, FORECAST_START)
MODEL_NAME = "HistGradientBoostingRegressor"

SURFACE = "#fcfcfb"
PRIMARY_TEXT = "#0b0b0b"
SECONDARY_TEXT = "#52514e"
MUTED_TEXT = "#898781"
GRID = "#e1e0d9"
AXIS = "#c3c2b7"
ACTUAL_COLOR = "#2a78d6"
FORECAST_COLOR = "#eb6834"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ForecastMetrics:
    mae_mw: float
    rmse_mw: float
    mape_percent: float
    mean_error_mw: float
    r_squared: float | None


def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            f"Forecast German hourly electricity load for {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} "
            "from earlier observations in the OPSD load dataset."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--data",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).with_name("opsd_de_load.csv"),
        help="Path to opsd_de_load.csv.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).parent,
        help="Directory for the forecast CSV, metrics JSON, and PNG plot.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def forecast_index(start: pd.Timestamp = FORECAST_START) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
    return pd.date_range(start, periods=FORECAST_HOURS, freq="h")


def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
    if missing_columns:
        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")

    if frame.empty:
        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")

    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
    load = load.sort_index()

    if load.index.has_duplicates:
        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")

    expected = pd.date_range(load.index[0], load.index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
    if not load.index.equals(expected):
        missing = expected.difference(load.index)
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is not continuous hourly data; {len(missing)} hours missing")

    earliest_start = min(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS)
    required_data_start = earliest_start - pd.Timedelta(
        hours=MIN_TRAINING_HISTORY_HOURS
    )
    latest_required_hour = max(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS) + pd.Timedelta(
        hours=FORECAST_HOURS - 1
    )
    if load.index[0] > required_data_start:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and lag features; "
            f"it must begin by {required_data_start.isoformat()}"
        )
    if load.index[-1] < latest_required_hour:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
            f"it must continue through {latest_required_hour.isoformat()}"
        )

    return load


def german_public_holidays(year: int) -> set[date]:
    easter_sunday = easter(year)
    return {
        date(year, 1, 1),
        easter_sunday - timedelta(days=2),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=1),
        date(year, 5, 1),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=39),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=50),
        date(year, 10, 3),
        date(year, 12, 25),
        date(year, 12, 26),
    }


def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
    holiday_years = range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2)
    holidays = set().union(*(german_public_holidays(year) for year in holiday_years))
    days_before_holidays = {holiday - timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}
    days_after_holidays = {holiday + timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}

    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
    frame["hour"] = hour
    frame["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
    frame["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
    frame["trend_years"] = (
        (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60)
    )
    frame["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
    frame["is_public_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_day_before_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in days_before_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_day_after_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in days_after_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_christmas_eve"] = np.fromiter(
        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 24) for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_new_years_eve"] = np.fromiter(
        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 31) for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )

    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3):
        frame[f"hour_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
        )
        frame[f"hour_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
        )
    for harmonic in (1, 2):
        frame[f"week_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
        )
        frame[f"week_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
        )
    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        frame[f"year_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
        )
        frame[f"year_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
        )

    return frame


def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
    lag_names: list[str] = []
    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
        name = f"lag_{lag}"
        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
        lag_names.append(name)

    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(168).mean()
    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(672).mean()
    features["lag_change_one_week"] = features["lag_168"] - features["lag_336"]
    return features


def make_model() -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor:
    return HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_iter=400,
        max_leaf_nodes=31,
        l2_regularization=1.0,
        random_state=42,
    )


def complete_training_rows(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    before: pd.Timestamp,
) -> pd.Series:
    return pd.Series(
        (features.index < before) & features.notna().all(axis=1),
        index=features.index,
    )


def train_and_predict(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    start: pd.Timestamp,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int, pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
    target = forecast_index(start)
    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")

    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
    if not train_rows.any():
        raise ValueError(f"No complete training rows are available before {start}")
    target_features = features.loc[target]
    if target_features.isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")

    model = make_model()
    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
    predictions = model.predict(target_features)
    training_index = features.index[train_rows]
    return predictions, int(train_rows.sum()), training_index[0], training_index[-1]


def calculate_metrics(
    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
) -> ForecastMetrics:
    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
    if actual_values.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")

    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
    return ForecastMetrics(
        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
        mape_percent=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors / actual_values)) * 100),
        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
        r_squared=r_squared,
    )


def relative_mape_improvement(
    model_mape: float,
    baseline_mape: float,
) -> float | None:
    if baseline_mape == 0:
        return None
    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100


def run_historical_validation(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:
        predictions, _, _, _ = train_and_predict(load, features, start)
        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, predictions)
        fold_scores[str(start.year)] = metrics.mape_percent
    return fold_scores


def style_axis(axis: Axes) -> None:
    axis.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    axis.tick_params(colors=MUTED_TEXT, labelsize=9, length=0)
    axis.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, linewidth=0.8)
    axis.set_axisbelow(True)
    axis.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["left"].set_color(AXIS)
    axis.spines["bottom"].set_color(AXIS)


def plot_forecast(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    plot_style = {
        "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
        "text.color": PRIMARY_TEXT,
        "axes.labelcolor": SECONDARY_TEXT,
        "axes.titlecolor": PRIMARY_TEXT,
    }
    with plt.rc_context(plot_style):
        _render_forecast_plot(table, metrics, output_path)


def _render_forecast_plot(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    figure, (load_axis, error_axis) = plt.subplots(
        2,
        1,
        figsize=(14, 8),
        sharex=True,
        gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": (3.2, 1), "hspace": 0.08},
        facecolor=SURFACE,
    )
    index = table.index
    actual = table["actual_load_mw"]
    forecast = table["forecast_load_mw"]
    errors = table["error_mw"]

    load_axis.plot(
        index,
        actual,
        color=ACTUAL_COLOR,
        linewidth=2,
        solid_capstyle="round",
        label="Actual load",
    )
    load_axis.plot(
        index,
        forecast,
        color=FORECAST_COLOR,
        linewidth=2,
        linestyle=(0, (4, 2)),
        dash_capstyle="round",
        label="Forecast load",
    )
    load_axis.fill_between(
        index,
        actual,
        forecast,
        color=FORECAST_COLOR,
        alpha=0.08,
        linewidth=0,
    )
    load_axis.set_ylabel("Load (MW)")
    load_axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
        plt.FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k")
    )
    load_axis.legend(
        loc="upper left",
        ncols=2,
        frameon=False,

        labelcolor=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )

    error_axis.plot(
        index,
        errors,

    )
    error_axis.fill_between(

    )
    error_axis.axhline(0, color=AXIS, linewidth=1)
    error_axis.set_ylabel("Error\n(MW)")
    error_axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
        plt.FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k")
    )
    error_limit = max(1_000.0, float(np.max(np.abs(errors))) * 1.15)
    error_axis.set_ylim(-error_limit, error_limit)
    error_axis.set_xlim(index[0], index[-1])
    error_axis.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.DayLocator(tz=timezone.utc))
    error_axis.xaxis.set_major_formatter(
        mdates.DateFormatter("%a\n%d %b", tz=timezone.utc)
    )
    error_axis.set_xlabel("Timestamp (UTC)")

    for axis in (load_axis, error_axis):
        style_axis(axis)

    figure.suptitle(
        "German electricity load: actual vs forecast",
        x=0.075,

        fontsize=18,

    )
    figure.text(

    figure.text(

def write_outputs(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
    predictions, training_hours, training_start, training_end = train_and_predict(
        load,
        features,
        FORECAST_START,
    )
    target = forecast_index()
    actual = load.loc[target].to_numpy()
    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, predictions)
    weekly_naive = features.loc[target, "lag_168"].to_numpy()
    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
    relative_mape_improvement = (
        (weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent - metrics.mape_percent)
        / weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent
        * 100
    )

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stem = "german_load_forecast_2020-01-01_to_2020-01-07"
    csv_path = output_dir / f"{stem}.csv"
    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{stem}_metrics.json"
    plot_path = output_dir / f"{stem}.png"

    errors = predictions - actual
    table = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "actual_load_mw": actual,
            "forecast_load_mw": predictions,
            "error_mw": errors,
            "absolute_percentage_error_percent": np.abs(errors / actual) * 100,
        },
        index=target,
    )
    table.index.name = "utc_timestamp"
    table.to_csv(csv_path, float_format="%.3f")

    report = {
        "model": MODEL_NAME,
        "feature_timezone": "Europe/Berlin",
        "target_start_utc": FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
        "target_end_utc_exclusive": FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
        "forecast_hours": FORECAST_HOURS,
        "training_start_utc": training_start.isoformat(),
        "training_end_utc": training_end.isoformat(),
        "training_hours": training_hours,
        "historical_validation_mape_percent_by_year": validation_scores,
        "historical_validation_mean_mape_percent": float(
            np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))
        ),
        "accuracy": asdict(metrics),
        "weekly_naive_baseline": asdict(weekly_naive_metrics),
        "mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent": float(
            relative_mape_improvement
        ),
    }
    metrics_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    plot_forecast(table, metrics, plot_path)
    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    load = load_hourly_series(args.data)
    features = build_feature_frame(load)
    csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics = write_outputs(
        load,
        features,
        args.output_dir,
    )

    print(f"Forecast complete: {FORECAST_HOURS} hourly values")
    print(f"MAPE: {metrics.mape_percent:.3f}%")
    print(f"MAE: {metrics.mae_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"RMSE: {metrics.rmse_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"R-squared: {metrics.r_squared:.4f}")
    print(f"Mean error: {metrics.mean_error_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"Forecast table: {csv_path}")
    print(f"Metrics report: {metrics_path}")
    print(f"Plot: {plot_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass

from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt
import pandas as pd
from dateutil.easter import easter
from matplotlib.axes import Axes
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor

TIMESTAMP_COLUMN = "utc_timestamp"
LOAD_COLUMN = "DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency"
FORECAST_START = pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC")
FORECAST_HOURS = 168
FORECAST_END = FORECAST_START + pd.Timedelta(hours=FORECAST_HOURS)
FORECAST_LAST = FORECAST_END - pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
FORECAST_DATE_LABEL = (
    f"{FORECAST_START.day}-{FORECAST_LAST.day} {FORECAST_START.strftime('%B %Y')}"
)
OUTPUT_STEM = (
    f"german_load_forecast_{FORECAST_START.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
    f"_to_{FORECAST_LAST.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
)
WEEKLY_LAGS = (168, 336, 504, 672)
MIN_TRAINING_HISTORY_HOURS = 840
VALIDATION_STARTS = (
    pd.Timestamp("2017-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
    pd.Timestamp("2018-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
    pd.Timestamp("2019-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
)
REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS = (*VALIDATION_STARTS, FORECAST_START)
MODEL_NAME = "HistGradientBoostingRegressor"

SURFACE = "#fcfcfb"
PRIMARY_TEXT = "#0b0b0b"
SECONDARY_TEXT = "#52514e"
MUTED_TEXT = "#898781"
GRID = "#e1e0d9"
AXIS = "#c3c2b7"
ACTUAL_COLOR = "#2a78d6"
FORECAST_COLOR = "#eb6834"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ForecastMetrics:
    mae_mw: float
    rmse_mw: float
    mape_percent: float
    mean_error_mw: float
    r_squared: float | None


def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            f"Forecast German hourly electricity load for {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} "
            "from earlier observations in the OPSD load dataset."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--data",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).with_name("opsd_de_load.csv"),
        help="Path to opsd_de_load.csv.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).parent,
        help="Directory for the forecast CSV, metrics JSON, and PNG plot.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def forecast_index(start: pd.Timestamp = FORECAST_START) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
    return pd.date_range(start, periods=FORECAST_HOURS, freq="h")


def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
    if missing_columns:
        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")

    if frame.empty:
        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")

    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
    load = load.sort_index()

    if load.index.has_duplicates:
        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")

    expected = pd.date_range(load.index[0], load.index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
    if not load.index.equals(expected):
        missing = expected.difference(load.index)
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is not continuous hourly data; {len(missing)} hours missing")

    earliest_start = min(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS)
    required_data_start = earliest_start - pd.Timedelta(
        hours=MIN_TRAINING_HISTORY_HOURS
    )
    latest_required_hour = max(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS) + pd.Timedelta(
        hours=FORECAST_HOURS - 1
    )
    if load.index[0] > required_data_start:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and lag features; "
            f"it must begin by {required_data_start.isoformat()}"
        )
    if load.index[-1] < latest_required_hour:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
            f"it must continue through {latest_required_hour.isoformat()}"
        )

    return load


def german_public_holidays(year: int) -> set[date]:
    easter_sunday = easter(year)
    return {
        date(year, 1, 1),
        easter_sunday - timedelta(days=2),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=1),
        date(year, 5, 1),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=39),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=50),
        date(year, 10, 3),
        date(year, 12, 25),
        date(year, 12, 26),
    }


def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
    holiday_years = range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2)
    holidays = set().union(*(german_public_holidays(year) for year in holiday_years))
    days_before_holidays = {holiday - timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}
    days_after_holidays = {holiday + timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}

    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
    frame["hour"] = hour
    frame["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
    frame["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
    frame["trend_years"] = (
        (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60)
    )
    frame["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
    frame["is_public_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_day_before_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in days_before_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_day_after_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in days_after_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_christmas_eve"] = np.fromiter(
        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 24) for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_new_years_eve"] = np.fromiter(
        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 31) for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )

    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3):
        frame[f"hour_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
        )
        frame[f"hour_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
        )
    for harmonic in (1, 2):
        frame[f"week_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
        )
        frame[f"week_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
        )
    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        frame[f"year_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
        )
        frame[f"year_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
        )

    return frame


def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
    lag_names: list[str] = []
    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
        name = f"lag_{lag}"
        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
        lag_names.append(name)

    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(168).mean()
    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(672).mean()
    features["lag_change_one_week"] = features["lag_168"] - features["lag_336"]
    return features


def make_model() -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor:
    return HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_iter=400,
        max_leaf_nodes=31,
        l2_regularization=1.0,
        random_state=42,
    )


def complete_training_rows(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    before: pd.Timestamp,
) -> pd.Series:
    return pd.Series(
        (features.index < before) & features.notna().all(axis=1),
        index=features.index,
    )


def train_and_predict(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    start: pd.Timestamp,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int, pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
    target = forecast_index(start)
    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")

    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
    if not train_rows.any():
        raise ValueError(f"No complete training rows are available before {start}")
    target_features = features.loc[target]
    if target_features.isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")

    model = make_model()
    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
    predictions = model.predict(target_features)
    training_index = features.index[train_rows]
    return predictions, int(train_rows.sum()), training_index[0], training_index[-1]


def calculate_metrics(
    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
) -> ForecastMetrics:
    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
    if actual_values.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")

    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
    return ForecastMetrics(
        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
        mape_percent=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors / actual_values)) * 100),
        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
        r_squared=r_squared,
    )


def relative_mape_improvement(
    model_mape: float,
    baseline_mape: float,
) -> float | None:
    if baseline_mape == 0:
        return None
    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100


def run_historical_validation(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:
        predictions, _, _, _ = train_and_predict(load, features, start)
        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, predictions)
        fold_scores[str(start.year)] = metrics.mape_percent
    return fold_scores


def style_axis(axis: Axes) -> None:
    axis.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    axis.tick_params(colors=MUTED_TEXT, labelsize=9, length=0)
    axis.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, linewidth=0.8)
    axis.set_axisbelow(True)
    axis.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["left"].set_color(AXIS)
    axis.spines["bottom"].set_color(AXIS)


def plot_forecast(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    plot_style = {
        "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
        "text.color": PRIMARY_TEXT,
        "axes.labelcolor": SECONDARY_TEXT,
        "axes.titlecolor": PRIMARY_TEXT,
    }
    with plt.rc_context(plot_style):
        _render_forecast_plot(table, metrics, output_path)


def _render_forecast_plot(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    figure, (load_axis, error_axis) = plt.subplots(
        2,
        1,
        figsize=(14, 8),
        sharex=True,
        gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": (3.2, 1), "hspace": 0.08},
        facecolor=SURFACE,
    )
    index = table.index
    actual = table["actual_load_mw"]
    forecast = table["forecast_load_mw"]
    errors = table["error_mw"]

    load_axis.plot(
        index,
        actual,
        color=ACTUAL_COLOR,
        linewidth=2,
        solid_capstyle="round",
        label="Actual load",
    )
    load_axis.plot(
        index,
        forecast,
        color=FORECAST_COLOR,
        linewidth=2,
        linestyle=(0, (4, 2)),
        dash_capstyle="round",
        label="Forecast load",
    )
    load_axis.fill_between(
        index,
        actual,
        forecast,
        color=FORECAST_COLOR,
        alpha=0.08,
        linewidth=0,
    )
    load_axis.set_ylabel("Load (MW)")
    load_axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
        plt.FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k")
    )
    load_axis.legend(
        loc="upper left",
        ncols=2,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=10,
        labelcolor=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )

    error_axis.plot(
        index,
        errors,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        linewidth=1.5,
        solid_capstyle="round",
    )
    error_axis.fill_between(
        index,
        0,
        errors,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        alpha=0.12,
        linewidth=0,
    )
    error_axis.axhline(0, color=AXIS, linewidth=1)
    error_axis.set_ylabel("Error\n(MW)")
    error_axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
        plt.FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k")
    )
    error_limit = max(1_000.0, float(np.max(np.abs(errors))) * 1.15)
    error_axis.set_ylim(-error_limit, error_limit)
    error_axis.set_xlim(index[0], index[-1])
    error_axis.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.DayLocator(tz=timezone.utc))
    error_axis.xaxis.set_major_formatter(
        mdates.DateFormatter("%a\n%d %b", tz=timezone.utc)
    )
    error_axis.set_xlabel("Timestamp (UTC)")

    for axis in (load_axis, error_axis):
        style_axis(axis)

    figure.suptitle(
        "German electricity load: actual vs forecast",
        x=0.075,
        y=0.975,
        ha="left",
        fontsize=18,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=PRIMARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.text(
        0.975,
        0.967,
        (
            f"MAPE {metrics.mape_percent:.2f}%   "
            f"MAE {metrics.mae_mw:,.0f} MW   "
            f"RMSE {metrics.rmse_mw:,.0f} MW"
        ),
        ha="right",
        va="top",
        fontsize=10,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.text(
        0.075,
        0.935,
        (
            f"{FORECAST_HOURS} hourly observations, {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} | "
            "Shaded area shows forecast error"
        ),
        ha="left",
        va="top",
        fontsize=10,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.subplots_adjust(left=0.075, right=0.975, bottom=0.105, top=0.89)
    try:
        figure.savefig(output_path, dpi=180, facecolor=SURFACE)
    finally:
        plt.close(figure)


def write_outputs(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
    predictions, training_hours, training_start, training_end = train_and_predict(
        load,
        features,
        FORECAST_START,
    )
    target = forecast_index()
    actual = load.loc[target].to_numpy()
    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, predictions)
    weekly_naive = features.loc[target, "lag_168"].to_numpy()
    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
    relative_mape_improvement = (
        (weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent - metrics.mape_percent)
        / weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent
        * 100
    )

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stem = "german_load_forecast_2020-01-01_to_2020-01-07"
    csv_path = output_dir / f"{stem}.csv"
    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{stem}_metrics.json"
    plot_path = output_dir / f"{stem}.png"

    errors = predictions - actual
    table = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "actual_load_mw": actual,
            "forecast_load_mw": predictions,
            "error_mw": errors,
            "absolute_percentage_error_percent": np.abs(errors / actual) * 100,
        },
        index=target,
    )
    table.index.name = "utc_timestamp"
    table.to_csv(csv_path, float_format="%.3f")

    report = {
        "model": MODEL_NAME,
        "feature_timezone": "Europe/Berlin",
        "target_start_utc": FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
        "target_end_utc_exclusive": FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
        "forecast_hours": FORECAST_HOURS,
        "training_start_utc": training_start.isoformat(),
        "training_end_utc": training_end.isoformat(),
        "training_hours": training_hours,
        "historical_validation_mape_percent_by_year": validation_scores,
        "historical_validation_mean_mape_percent": float(
            np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))
        ),
        "accuracy": asdict(metrics),
        "weekly_naive_baseline": asdict(weekly_naive_metrics),
        "mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent": float(
            relative_mape_improvement
        ),
    }
    metrics_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    plot_forecast(table, metrics, plot_path)
    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    load = load_hourly_series(args.data)
    features = build_feature_frame(load)
    csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics = write_outputs(
        load,
        features,
        args.output_dir,
    )

    print(f"Forecast complete: {FORECAST_HOURS} hourly values")
    print(f"MAPE: {metrics.mape_percent:.3f}%")
    print(f"MAE: {metrics.mae_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"RMSE: {metrics.rmse_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"R-squared: {metrics.r_squared:.4f}")
    print(f"Mean error: {metrics.mean_error_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"Forecast table: {csv_path}")
    print(f"Metrics report: {metrics_path}")
    print(f"Plot: {plot_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ForecastMetrics:
    mae_mw: float
    rmse_mw: float
    mape_percent: float
    mean_error_mw: float
    r_squared: float | None


def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            f"Forecast German hourly electricity load for {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} "
            "from earlier observations in the OPSD load dataset."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--data",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).with_name("opsd_de_load.csv"),
        help="Path to opsd_de_load.csv.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).parent,
        help="Directory for the forecast CSV, metrics JSON, and PNG plot.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def forecast_index(start: pd.Timestamp = FORECAST_START) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
    return pd.date_range(start, periods=FORECAST_HOURS, freq="h")


def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
    if missing_columns:
        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")

    if frame.empty:
        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")

    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
    load = load.sort_index()

    if load.index.has_duplicates:
        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")

    expected = pd.date_range(load.index[0], load.index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
    if not load.index.equals(expected):
        missing = expected.difference(load.index)
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is not continuous hourly data; {len(missing)} hours missing")

    earliest_start = min(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS)
    required_data_start = earliest_start - pd.Timedelta(
        hours=MIN_TRAINING_HISTORY_HOURS
    )
    latest_required_hour = max(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS) + pd.Timedelta(
        hours=FORECAST_HOURS - 1
    )
    if load.index[0] > required_data_start:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and lag features; "
            f"it must begin by {required_data_start.isoformat()}"
        )
    if load.index[-1] < latest_required_hour:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
            f"it must continue through {latest_required_hour.isoformat()}"
        )

    return load


def german_public_holidays(year: int) -> set[date]:
    easter_sunday = easter(year)
    return {
        date(year, 1, 1),
        easter_sunday - timedelta(days=2),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=1),
        date(year, 5, 1),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=39),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=50),
        date(year, 10, 3),
        date(year, 12, 25),
        date(year, 12, 26),
    }


def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
    holiday_years = range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2)
    holidays = set().union(*(german_public_holidays(year) for year in holiday_years))
    days_before_holidays = {holiday - timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}
    days_after_holidays = {holiday + timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}

    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
    frame["hour"] = hour
    frame["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
    frame["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
    frame["trend_years"] = (
        (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60)
    )
    frame["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
    frame["is_public_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_day_before_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in days_before_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_day_after_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in days_after_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_christmas_eve"] = np.fromiter(
        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 24) for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_new_years_eve"] = np.fromiter(
        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 31) for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )

    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3):
        frame[f"hour_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
        )
        frame[f"hour_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
        )
    for harmonic in (1, 2):
        frame[f"week_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
        )
        frame[f"week_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
        )
    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        frame[f"year_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
        )
        frame[f"year_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
        )

    return frame


def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
    lag_names: list[str] = []
    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
        name = f"lag_{lag}"
        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
        lag_names.append(name)

    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(168).mean()
    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(672).mean()
    features["lag_change_one_week"] = features["lag_168"] - features["lag_336"]
    return features


def make_model() -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor:
    return HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_iter=400,
        max_leaf_nodes=31,
        l2_regularization=1.0,
        random_state=42,
    )


def complete_training_rows(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    before: pd.Timestamp,
) -> pd.Series:
    return pd.Series(
        (features.index < before) & features.notna().all(axis=1),
        index=features.index,
    )


def train_and_predict(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    start: pd.Timestamp,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int, pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
    target = forecast_index(start)
    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")

    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
    if not train_rows.any():
        raise ValueError(f"No complete training rows are available before {start}")
    target_features = features.loc[target]
    if target_features.isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")

    model = make_model()
    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
    predictions = model.predict(target_features)
    training_index = features.index[train_rows]
    return predictions, int(train_rows.sum()), training_index[0], training_index[-1]


def calculate_metrics(
    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
) -> ForecastMetrics:
    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
    if actual_values.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")

    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
    return ForecastMetrics(
        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
        mape_percent=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors / actual_values)) * 100),
        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
        r_squared=r_squared,
    )


def relative_mape_improvement(
    model_mape: float,
    baseline_mape: float,
) -> float | None:
    if baseline_mape == 0:
        return None
    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100


def run_historical_validation(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:
        predictions, _, _, _ = train_and_predict(load, features, start)
        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, predictions)
        fold_scores[str(start.year)] = metrics.mape_percent
    return fold_scores


def style_axis(axis: Axes) -> None:
    axis.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    axis.tick_params(colors=MUTED_TEXT, labelsize=9, length=0)
    axis.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, linewidth=0.8)
    axis.set_axisbelow(True)
    axis.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["left"].set_color(AXIS)
    axis.spines["bottom"].set_color(AXIS)


def plot_forecast(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    plot_style = {
        "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
        "text.color": PRIMARY_TEXT,
        "axes.labelcolor": SECONDARY_TEXT,
        "axes.titlecolor": PRIMARY_TEXT,
    }
    with plt.rc_context(plot_style):
        _render_forecast_plot(table, metrics, output_path)


def _render_forecast_plot(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    figure, (load_axis, error_axis) = plt.subplots(
        2,
        1,
        figsize=(14, 8),
        sharex=True,
        gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": (3.2, 1), "hspace": 0.08},
        facecolor=SURFACE,
    )
    index = table.index
    actual = table["actual_load_mw"]
    forecast = table["forecast_load_mw"]
    errors = table["error_mw"]

    load_axis.plot(
        index,
        actual,
        color=ACTUAL_COLOR,
        linewidth=2,
        solid_capstyle="round",
        label="Actual load",
    )
    load_axis.plot(
        index,
        forecast,
        color=FORECAST_COLOR,
        linewidth=2,
        linestyle=(0, (4, 2)),
        dash_capstyle="round",
        label="Forecast load",
    )
    load_axis.fill_between(
        index,
        actual,
        forecast,
        color=FORECAST_COLOR,
        alpha=0.08,
        linewidth=0,
    )
    load_axis.set_ylabel("Load (MW)")
    load_axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
        plt.FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k")
    )
    load_axis.legend(
        loc="upper left",
        ncols=2,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=10,
        labelcolor=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )

    error_axis.plot(
        index,
        errors,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        linewidth=1.5,
        solid_capstyle="round",
    )
    error_axis.fill_between(
        index,
        0,
        errors,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        alpha=0.12,
        linewidth=0,
    )
    error_axis.axhline(0, color=AXIS, linewidth=1)
    error_axis.set_ylabel("Error\n(MW)")
    error_axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
        plt.FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k")
    )
    error_limit = max(1_000.0, float(np.max(np.abs(errors))) * 1.15)
    error_axis.set_ylim(-error_limit, error_limit)
    error_axis.set_xlim(index[0], index[-1])
    error_axis.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.DayLocator(tz=timezone.utc))
    error_axis.xaxis.set_major_formatter(
        mdates.DateFormatter("%a\n%d %b", tz=timezone.utc)
    )
    error_axis.set_xlabel("Timestamp (UTC)")

    for axis in (load_axis, error_axis):
        style_axis(axis)

    figure.suptitle(
        "German electricity load: actual vs forecast",
        x=0.075,
        y=0.975,
        ha="left",
        fontsize=18,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=PRIMARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.text(
        0.975,
        0.967,
        (
            f"MAPE {metrics.mape_percent:.2f}%   "
            f"MAE {metrics.mae_mw:,.0f} MW   "
            f"RMSE {metrics.rmse_mw:,.0f} MW"
        ),
        ha="right",
        va="top",
        fontsize=10,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.text(
        0.075,
        0.935,
        (
            f"{FORECAST_HOURS} hourly observations, {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} | "
            "Shaded area shows forecast error"
        ),
        ha="left",
        va="top",
        fontsize=10,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.subplots_adjust(left=0.075, right=0.975, bottom=0.105, top=0.89)
    try:
        figure.savefig(output_path, dpi=180, facecolor=SURFACE)
    finally:
        plt.close(figure)


def write_outputs(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
    predictions, training_hours, training_start, training_end = train_and_predict(
        load,
        features,
        FORECAST_START,
    )
    target = forecast_index()
    actual = load.loc[target].to_numpy()
    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, predictions)
    weekly_naive = features.loc[target, "lag_168"].to_numpy()
    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
    )

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"

    errors = predictions - actual
    table = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "actual_load_mw": actual,
            "forecast_load_mw": predictions,
            "error_mw": errors,
            "absolute_percentage_error_percent": np.abs(errors / actual) * 100,
        },
        index=target,
    )
    table.index.name = "utc_timestamp"
    table.to_csv(csv_path, float_format="%.3f")

    report = {
        "model": MODEL_NAME,
        "feature_timezone": "Europe/Berlin",
        "target_start_utc": FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
        "target_end_utc_exclusive": FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
        "forecast_hours": FORECAST_HOURS,
        "training_start_utc": training_start.isoformat(),
        "training_end_utc": training_end.isoformat(),
        "training_hours": training_hours,
        "historical_validation_mape_percent_by_year": validation_scores,
        "historical_validation_mean_mape_percent": float(
            np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))
        ),
        "accuracy": asdict(metrics),
        "weekly_naive_baseline": asdict(weekly_naive_metrics),
        "mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent": float(
            relative_mape_improvement
        ),
    }
    metrics_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    plot_forecast(table, metrics, plot_path)
    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    load = load_hourly_series(args.data)
    features = build_feature_frame(load)
    csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics = write_outputs(
        load,
        features,
        args.output_dir,
    )

    print(f"Forecast complete: {FORECAST_HOURS} hourly values")
    print(f"MAPE: {metrics.mape_percent:.3f}%")
    print(f"MAE: {metrics.mae_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"RMSE: {metrics.rmse_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"R-squared: {metrics.r_squared:.4f}")
    print(f"Mean error: {metrics.mean_error_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"Forecast table: {csv_path}")
    print(f"Metrics report: {metrics_path}")
    print(f"Plot: {plot_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def forecast_index(start: pd.Timestamp = FORECAST_START) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:

def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
    if missing_columns:
        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")

    if frame.empty:
        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")

    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
    load = load.sort_index()

    if load.index.has_duplicates:
        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")

    expected = pd.date_range(load.index[0], load.index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
    if not load.index.equals(expected):
        missing = expected.difference(load.index)
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is not continuous hourly data; {len(missing)} hours missing")

    earliest_start = min(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS)
    required_data_start = earliest_start - pd.Timedelta(
        hours=MIN_TRAINING_HISTORY_HOURS
    )
    latest_required_hour = max(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS) + pd.Timedelta(
        hours=FORECAST_HOURS - 1
    )
    if load.index[0] > required_data_start:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and lag features; "
            f"it must begin by {required_data_start.isoformat()}"
        )
    if load.index[-1] < latest_required_hour:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
            f"it must continue through {latest_required_hour.isoformat()}"
        )

    return load


def german_public_holidays(year: int) -> set[date]:
    easter_sunday = easter(year)
    return {
        date(year, 1, 1),
        easter_sunday - timedelta(days=2),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=1),
        date(year, 5, 1),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=39),
        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=50),
        date(year, 10, 3),
        date(year, 12, 25),
        date(year, 12, 26),
    }


def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
    holiday_years = range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2)
    holidays = set().union(*(german_public_holidays(year) for year in holiday_years))
    days_before_holidays = {holiday - timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}
    days_after_holidays = {holiday + timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}

    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
    frame["hour"] = hour
    frame["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
    frame["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    frame["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
    frame["trend_years"] = (
        (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60)
    )
    frame["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
    frame["is_public_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_day_before_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in days_before_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_day_after_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
        (local_date in days_after_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_christmas_eve"] = np.fromiter(
        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 24) for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )
    frame["is_new_years_eve"] = np.fromiter(
        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 31) for local_date in local_dates),
        dtype=float,
        count=len(index),
    )

    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3):
        frame[f"hour_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
        )
        frame[f"hour_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
        )
    for harmonic in (1, 2):
        frame[f"week_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
        )
        frame[f"week_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
        )
    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        frame[f"year_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
        )
        frame[f"year_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
        )

    return frame


def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
    lag_names: list[str] = []
    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
        name = f"lag_{lag}"
        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
        lag_names.append(name)

    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(168).mean()
    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(672).mean()
    features["lag_change_one_week"] = features["lag_168"] - features["lag_336"]
    return features


def make_model() -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor:
    return HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_iter=400,
        max_leaf_nodes=31,
        l2_regularization=1.0,
        random_state=42,
    )


def complete_training_rows(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    before: pd.Timestamp,
) -> pd.Series:
    return pd.Series(
        (features.index < before) & features.notna().all(axis=1),
        index=features.index,
    )


def train_and_predict(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    start: pd.Timestamp,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int, pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
    target = forecast_index(start)
    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")

    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
    if not train_rows.any():
        raise ValueError(f"No complete training rows are available before {start}")
    target_features = features.loc[target]
    if target_features.isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")

    model = make_model()
    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
    predictions = model.predict(target_features)
    training_index = features.index[train_rows]
    return predictions, int(train_rows.sum()), training_index[0], training_index[-1]


def calculate_metrics(
    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
) -> ForecastMetrics:
    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
    if actual_values.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")

    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
    return ForecastMetrics(
        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
        mape_percent=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors / actual_values)) * 100),
        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
        r_squared=r_squared,
    )


def relative_mape_improvement(
    model_mape: float,
    baseline_mape: float,
) -> float | None:
    if baseline_mape == 0:
        return None
    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100


def run_historical_validation(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:
        predictions, _, _, _ = train_and_predict(load, features, start)
        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, predictions)
        fold_scores[str(start.year)] = metrics.mape_percent
    return fold_scores


def style_axis(axis: Axes) -> None:
    axis.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    axis.tick_params(colors=MUTED_TEXT, labelsize=9, length=0)
    axis.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, linewidth=0.8)
    axis.set_axisbelow(True)
    axis.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["left"].set_color(AXIS)
    axis.spines["bottom"].set_color(AXIS)


def plot_forecast(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    plot_style = {
        "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
        "text.color": PRIMARY_TEXT,
        "axes.labelcolor": SECONDARY_TEXT,
        "axes.titlecolor": PRIMARY_TEXT,
    }
    with plt.rc_context(plot_style):
        _render_forecast_plot(table, metrics, output_path)


def _render_forecast_plot(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    figure, (load_axis, error_axis) = plt.subplots(
        2,
        1,
        figsize=(14, 8),
        sharex=True,
        gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": (3.2, 1), "hspace": 0.08},
        facecolor=SURFACE,
    )
    index = table.index
    actual = table["actual_load_mw"]
    forecast = table["forecast_load_mw"]
    errors = table["error_mw"]

    load_axis.plot(
        index,
        actual,
        color=ACTUAL_COLOR,
        linewidth=2,
        solid_capstyle="round",
        label="Actual load",
    )
    load_axis.plot(
        index,
        forecast,
        color=FORECAST_COLOR,
        linewidth=2,
        linestyle=(0, (4, 2)),
        dash_capstyle="round",
        label="Forecast load",
    )
    load_axis.fill_between(
        index,
        actual,
        forecast,
        color=FORECAST_COLOR,
        alpha=0.08,
        linewidth=0,
    )
    load_axis.set_ylabel("Load (MW)")
    load_axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
        plt.FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k")
    )
    load_axis.legend(
        loc="upper left",
        ncols=2,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=10,
        labelcolor=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )

    error_axis.plot(
        index,
        errors,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        linewidth=1.5,
        solid_capstyle="round",
    )
    error_axis.fill_between(
        index,
        0,
        errors,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        alpha=0.12,
        linewidth=0,
    )
    error_axis.axhline(0, color=AXIS, linewidth=1)
    error_axis.set_ylabel("Error\n(MW)")
    error_axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
        plt.FuncFormatter(lambda value, _: f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k")
    )
    error_limit = max(1_000.0, float(np.max(np.abs(errors))) * 1.15)
    error_axis.set_ylim(-error_limit, error_limit)
    error_axis.set_xlim(index[0], index[-1])
    error_axis.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.DayLocator(tz=timezone.utc))
    error_axis.xaxis.set_major_formatter(
        mdates.DateFormatter("%a\n%d %b", tz=timezone.utc)
    )
    error_axis.set_xlabel("Timestamp (UTC)")

    for axis in (load_axis, error_axis):
        style_axis(axis)

    figure.suptitle(
        "German electricity load: actual vs forecast",
        x=0.075,
        y=0.975,
        ha="left",
        fontsize=18,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=PRIMARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.text(
        0.975,
        0.967,
        (
            f"MAPE {metrics.mape_percent:.2f}%   "
            f"MAE {metrics.mae_mw:,.0f} MW   "
            f"RMSE {metrics.rmse_mw:,.0f} MW"
        ),
        ha="right",
        va="top",
        fontsize=10,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.text(
        0.075,
        0.935,
        (
            f"{FORECAST_HOURS} hourly observations, {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} | "
            "Shaded area shows forecast error"
        ),
        ha="left",
        va="top",
        fontsize=10,
        color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
    )
    figure.subplots_adjust(left=0.075, right=0.975, bottom=0.105, top=0.89)
    try:
        figure.savefig(output_path, dpi=180, facecolor=SURFACE)
    finally:
        plt.close(figure)


def write_outputs(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
    predictions, training_hours, training_start, training_end = train_and_predict(
        load,
        features,
        FORECAST_START,
    )
    target = forecast_index()
    actual = load.loc[target].to_numpy()
    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, predictions)
    weekly_naive = features.loc[target, "lag_168"].to_numpy()
    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
    )

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"

    errors = predictions - actual
    table = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "actual_load_mw": actual,
            "forecast_load_mw": predictions,
            "error_mw": errors,
            "absolute_percentage_error_percent": np.abs(errors / actual) * 100,
        },
        index=target,
    )
    table.index.name = TIMESTAMP_COLUMN

    report = {
        "model": MODEL_NAME,
        "feature_timezone": "Europe/Berlin",
        "target_start_utc": FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
        "target_end_utc_exclusive": FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
        "forecast_hours": FORECAST_HOURS,
        "training_start_utc": training_start.isoformat(),
        "training_end_utc": training_end.isoformat(),
        "training_hours": training_hours,
        "historical_validation_mape_percent_by_year": validation_scores,
        "historical_validation_mean_mape_percent": float(
            np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))
        ),
        "accuracy": asdict(metrics),
        "weekly_naive_baseline": asdict(weekly_naive_metrics),
        "mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent": mape_improvement,
    }
    report_json = json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n"

    with TemporaryDirectory(dir=output_dir, prefix=f".{OUTPUT_STEM}-") as temporary:
        temporary_dir = Path(temporary)
        temporary_csv = temporary_dir / csv_path.name
        temporary_metrics = temporary_dir / metrics_path.name
        temporary_plot = temporary_dir / plot_path.name

        table.to_csv(temporary_csv, float_format="%.3f")
        temporary_metrics.write_text(report_json, encoding="utf-8")
        plot_forecast(table, metrics, temporary_plot)

        os.replace(temporary_csv, csv_path)
        os.replace(temporary_plot, plot_path)
        os.replace(temporary_metrics, metrics_path)

    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    load = load_hourly_series(args.data)
    features = build_feature_frame(load)
    csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics = write_outputs(
        load,
        features,
        args.output_dir,
    )

    print(f"Forecast complete: {FORECAST_HOURS} hourly values")
    print(f"MAPE: {metrics.mape_percent:.3f}%")
    print(f"MAE: {metrics.mae_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"RMSE: {metrics.rmse_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"R-squared: {metrics.r_squared:.4f}")
    print(f"Mean error: {metrics.mean_error_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"Forecast table: {csv_path}")
    print(f"Metrics report: {metrics_path}")
    print(f"Plot: {plot_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

93	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
94	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
95	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
96	    if missing_columns:
97	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
98	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
99	
100	    if frame.empty:
101	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
102	
103	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
104	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
105	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
106	    load = load.sort_index()
107	
108	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
109	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
110	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
111	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
112	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
113	
114	    expected = pd.date_range(load.index[0], load.index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
115	    if not load.index.equals(expected):
116	        missing = expected.difference(load.index)
117	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is not continuous hourly data; {len(missing)} hours missing")
118	
119	    earliest_start = min(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS)
120	    required_data_start = earliest_start - pd.Timedelta(
121	        hours=MIN_TRAINING_HISTORY_HOURS
122	    )
123	    latest_required_hour = max(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS) + pd.Timedelta(
124	        hours=FORECAST_HOURS - 1
125	    )
126	    if load.index[0] > required_data_start:
127	        raise ValueError(
128	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and lag features; "
129	            f"it must begin by {required_data_start.isoformat()}"
130	        )
131	    if load.index[-1] < latest_required_hour:
132	        raise ValueError(
133	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
134	            f"it must continue through {latest_required_hour.isoformat()}"
135	        )
136	
137	    return load

140	def german_public_holidays(year: int) -> set[date]:
141	    easter_sunday = easter(year)
142	    return {
143	        date(year, 1, 1),
144	        easter_sunday - timedelta(days=2),
145	        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=1),
146	        date(year, 5, 1),
147	        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=39),
148	        easter_sunday + timedelta(days=50),
149	        date(year, 10, 3),
150	        date(year, 12, 25),
151	        date(year, 12, 26),
152	    }

155	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
156	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
157	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
158	    holiday_years = range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2)
159	    holidays = set().union(*(german_public_holidays(year) for year in holiday_years))
160	    days_before_holidays = {holiday - timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}
161	    days_after_holidays = {holiday + timedelta(days=1) for holiday in holidays}
162	
163	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
164	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
165	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
166	    frame = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
167	    frame["hour"] = hour
168	    frame["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
169	    frame["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
170	    frame["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
171	    frame["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
172	    frame["trend_years"] = (
173	        (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60)
174	    )
175	    frame["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
176	    frame["is_public_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
177	        (local_date in holidays for local_date in local_dates),
178	        dtype=float,
179	        count=len(index),
180	    )
181	    frame["is_day_before_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
182	        (local_date in days_before_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
183	        dtype=float,
184	        count=len(index),
185	    )
186	    frame["is_day_after_holiday"] = np.fromiter(
187	        (local_date in days_after_holidays for local_date in local_dates),
188	        dtype=float,
189	        count=len(index),
190	    )
191	    frame["is_christmas_eve"] = np.fromiter(
192	        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 24) for local_date in local_dates),
193	        dtype=float,
194	        count=len(index),
195	    )
196	    frame["is_new_years_eve"] = np.fromiter(
197	        ((local_date.month, local_date.day) == (12, 31) for local_date in local_dates),
198	        dtype=float,
199	        count=len(index),
200	    )
201	
202	    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3):
203	        frame[f"hour_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
204	            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
205	        )
206	        frame[f"hour_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
207	            2 * np.pi * harmonic * hour / 24
208	        )
209	    for harmonic in (1, 2):
210	        frame[f"week_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
211	            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
212	        )
213	        frame[f"week_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
214	            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_week / 7
215	        )
216	    for harmonic in (1, 2, 3, 4):
217	        frame[f"year_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(
218	            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
219	        )
220	        frame[f"year_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(
221	            2 * np.pi * harmonic * day_of_year / 365.25
222	        )
223	
224	    return frame

227	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
228	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
229	    lag_names: list[str] = []
230	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
231	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
232	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
233	        lag_names.append(name)
234	
235	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
236	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
237	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
238	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(168).mean()
239	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = load.shift(168).rolling(672).mean()
240	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = features["lag_168"] - features["lag_336"]
241	    return features

244	def make_model() -> HistGradientBoostingRegressor:
245	    return HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
246	        learning_rate=0.05,
247	        max_iter=400,
248	        max_leaf_nodes=31,
249	        l2_regularization=1.0,
250	        random_state=42,
251	    )

254	def complete_training_rows(
255	    features: pd.DataFrame,
256	    before: pd.Timestamp,
257	) -> pd.Series:
258	    return pd.Series(
259	        (features.index < before) & features.notna().all(axis=1),
260	        index=features.index,
261	    )

264	def train_and_predict(
265	    load: pd.Series,
266	    features: pd.DataFrame,
267	    start: pd.Timestamp,
268	) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int, pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
269	    target = forecast_index(start)
270	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
271	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
272	
273	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
274	    if not train_rows.any():
275	        raise ValueError(f"No complete training rows are available before {start}")
276	    target_features = features.loc[target]
277	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
278	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
279	
280	    model = make_model()
281	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
282	    predictions = model.predict(target_features)
283	    training_index = features.index[train_rows]
284	    return predictions, int(train_rows.sum()), training_index[0], training_index[-1]
