    weekly_naive_baseline: ForecastMetrics
    mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent: float | None


def format_date_range(start: pd.Timestamp, end_inclusive: pd.Timestamp) -> str:
    start_date = start.date()
    end_date = end_inclusive.date()
    if start_date == end_date:
        return f"{start_date.day} {start.strftime('%B %Y')}"
    if (start_date.year, start_date.month) == (end_date.year, end_date.month):
        return f"{start_date.day}-{end_date.day} {start.strftime('%B %Y')}"
    if start_date.year == end_date.year:
        return (
            f"{start_date.day} {start.strftime('%B')}-"
            f"{end_date.day} {end_inclusive.strftime('%B %Y')}"
        )
    return (
        f"{start_date.day} {start.strftime('%B %Y')}-"
        f"{end_date.day} {end_inclusive.strftime('%B %Y')}"
    )


FORECAST_DATE_LABEL = format_date_range(FORECAST_START, FORECAST_LAST)
OUTPUT_STEM = (
    f"german_load_forecast_{FORECAST_START.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
    f"_to_{FORECAST_LAST.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
)
MODEL_PARAMETERS = ModelParameters()


def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            f"Forecast German hourly electricity load for {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} "
            "from earlier observations in the OPSD load dataset."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--data",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).with_name("opsd_de_load.csv"),
        help="Path to opsd_de_load.csv.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).parent,
        help="Directory for the forecast CSV, metrics JSON, and PNG plot.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def forecast_index(start: pd.Timestamp = FORECAST_START) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
    if start.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("Forecast start must be timezone-aware")
    return pd.date_range(start, periods=FORECAST_HOURS, freq="h")


def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
    if missing_columns:
        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
    if frame.empty:
        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")

    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
    load = load.sort_index()

    if load.index.has_duplicates:
        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
    if missing_values:
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
        )
    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
        )

    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
    index = load.index
    off_grid = (
        (index.minute != 0)
        | (index.second != 0)
        | (index.microsecond != 0)
        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
    )
    if off_grid.any():
        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")

    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
    if not index.equals(expected):
        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
        )

    return load


def date_membership(
    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
    members: set[date],
) -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
    return np.asarray(pd.Index(local_dates).isin(members), dtype=np.float64)


def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
    days_before_holidays = {
        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
    }
    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
    reduced_load_days = {
        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
    }

    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
    features["hour"] = hour
    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
        local_dates,
        days_before_holidays,
    )
    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
        local_dates,
        days_after_holidays,
    )
    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)

    harmonic_groups = (
        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
    )
    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)

    return features


def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
    lag_names: list[str] = []
    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
        name = f"lag_{lag}"
        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
        lag_names.append(name)

    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
    )
    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
    )
    return features


def make_model() -> LGBMRegressor:
    return LGBMRegressor(
        n_estimators=MODEL_PARAMETERS.n_estimators,
        learning_rate=MODEL_PARAMETERS.learning_rate,
        num_leaves=MODEL_PARAMETERS.num_leaves,
        min_child_samples=MODEL_PARAMETERS.min_child_samples,
        reg_lambda=MODEL_PARAMETERS.reg_lambda,
        random_state=MODEL_PARAMETERS.random_state,
        verbosity=-1,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )


def complete_training_rows(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    before: pd.Timestamp,
) -> pd.Series:
    return (features.index < before) & features.notna().all(axis=1)


def train_and_predict(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    start: pd.Timestamp,
) -> ModelForecast:
    target = forecast_index(start)
    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")

    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
        )

    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
    if target_features.isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")

    model = make_model()
    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
    return ModelForecast(
        predictions=predictions,
        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
    )


def calculate_metrics(
    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
) -> ForecastMetrics:
    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
    if actual_values.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")

    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
    return ForecastMetrics(
        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
        r_squared=r_squared,
    )


def relative_mape_improvement(
    model_mape: float,
    baseline_mape: float,
) -> float | None:
    if baseline_mape == 0:
        return None
    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100


def run_historical_validation(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:
        forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, start)
        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
        fold_scores[start.isoformat()] = metrics.mape_percent
    return fold_scores


def build_forecast_table(
    target: pd.DatetimeIndex,
    actual: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
    predicted: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    errors = predicted - actual
    table = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "actual_load_mw": actual,
            "forecast_load_mw": predicted,
            "error_mw": errors,
            "absolute_percentage_error_percent": np.abs(errors / actual) * 100,
        },
        index=target,
    )
    table.index.name = TIMESTAMP_COLUMN
    return table


def format_megawatt_tick(value: float, _: float) -> str:
    if abs(value) >= 10_000:
        return f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k"
    if abs(value) >= 1_000:
        return f"{value / 1_000:.1f}k"
    return f"{value:,.0f}"


def style_axis(axis: Axes) -> None:
    axis.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    axis.tick_params(colors=MUTED_TEXT, labelsize=9, length=0)
    axis.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, linewidth=0.8)
    axis.set_axisbelow(True)
    axis.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["left"].set_color(AXIS)
    axis.spines["bottom"].set_color(AXIS)
    axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(format_megawatt_tick))


def plot_forecast(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    plot_style: dict[str, object] = {
        "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
        "text.color": PRIMARY_TEXT,
        "axes.labelcolor": SECONDARY_TEXT,
        "axes.titlecolor": PRIMARY_TEXT,
    }
    with matplotlib.rc_context(plot_style):
        figure = Figure(figsize=(14, 8), facecolor=SURFACE)
        FigureCanvasAgg(figure)
        load_axis, error_axis = figure.subplots(
            2,
            1,
            sharex=True,
            gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": (3.2, 1), "hspace": 0.08},
        )
        index = table.index
        actual = table["actual_load_mw"]
        predicted = table["forecast_load_mw"]
        errors = table["error_mw"]

        load_axis.plot(
            index,
            actual,
            color=ACTUAL_COLOR,
            linewidth=2,
            solid_capstyle="round",
            label="Actual load",
        )
        load_axis.plot(
            index,
            predicted,
            color=FORECAST_COLOR,
            linewidth=2,
            linestyle=(0, (4, 2)),
            dash_capstyle="round",
            label="Forecast load",
        )
        load_axis.fill_between(
            index,
            actual,
            predicted,
            color=FORECAST_COLOR,
            alpha=0.08,
            linewidth=0,
        )
        load_axis.set_ylabel("Load (MW)")
        load_axis.legend(
            loc="upper left",
            ncols=2,
            frameon=False,
            fontsize=10,
            labelcolor=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        )

        error_axis.plot(
            index,
            errors,
            color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
            linewidth=1.5,
            solid_capstyle="round",
        )
        error_axis.fill_between(
            index,
            0,
            errors,
            color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
            alpha=0.12,
            linewidth=0,
        )
        error_axis.axhline(0, color=AXIS, linewidth=1)
        error_axis.set_ylabel("Error\n(MW)")
        error_limit = max(1_000.0, float(np.max(np.abs(errors))) * 1.15)
        error_axis.set_ylim(-error_limit, error_limit)
        error_axis.set_xlim(index[0], index[-1])
        daily_ticks = pd.date_range(index[0].floor("D"), index[-1], freq="D")
        error_axis.set_xticks(daily_ticks.to_pydatetime())
        error_axis.set_xticklabels([timestamp.strftime("%a\n%d %b") for timestamp in daily_ticks])
        error_axis.set_xlabel("Timestamp (UTC)")

        for axis in (load_axis, error_axis):
            style_axis(axis)

        figure.suptitle(
            "German electricity load: actual vs forecast",
            x=0.075,
            y=0.975,
            ha="left",
            fontsize=18,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=PRIMARY_TEXT,
        )
        figure.text(
            0.975,
            0.967,
            (
                f"MAPE {metrics.mape_percent:.2f}%   "
                f"MAE {metrics.mae_mw:,.0f} MW   "
                f"RMSE {metrics.rmse_mw:,.0f} MW"
            ),
            ha="right",
            va="top",
            fontsize=10,
            color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        )
        figure.text(
            0.075,
            0.935,
            (
                f"{FORECAST_HOURS} hourly observations, {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} | "
                "Shaded area shows forecast error"
            ),
            ha="left",
            va="top",
            fontsize=10,
            color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        )
        figure.subplots_adjust(left=0.075, right=0.975, bottom=0.105, top=0.89)
        figure.savefig(output_path, dpi=180, facecolor=SURFACE)


def write_outputs(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
    forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, FORECAST_START)
    target = forecast_index()
    actual = np.asarray(load.loc[target].to_numpy(), dtype=np.float64)
    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
    weekly_naive = np.asarray(
        features.loc[target, f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"].to_numpy(),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
    )
    training_index = forecast.training_index

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"
    table = build_forecast_table(target, actual, forecast.predictions)

    report = ForecastReport(
        model=type(make_model()).__name__,
        model_library="lightgbm",
        model_library_version=lightgbm.__version__,
        model_parameters=MODEL_PARAMETERS,
        feature_timezone="Europe/Berlin",
        target_start_utc=FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
        target_end_utc_exclusive=FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
        forecast_hours=FORECAST_HOURS,
        training_start_utc=training_index[0].isoformat(),
        training_end_utc=training_index[-1].isoformat(),
        training_hours=len(training_index),
        historical_validation_mape_percent_by_start_utc=validation_scores,
        historical_validation_mean_mape_percent=float(np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))),
        accuracy=metrics,
        weekly_naive_baseline=weekly_naive_metrics,
        mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent=mape_improvement,
    )
    report_json = json.dumps(asdict(report), indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n"

    with TemporaryDirectory(dir=output_dir, prefix=f".{OUTPUT_STEM}-") as temporary:
        temporary_dir = Path(temporary)
        artifact_pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path]] = [
            (temporary_dir / csv_path.name, csv_path),
            (temporary_dir / metrics_path.name, metrics_path),
            (temporary_dir / plot_path.name, plot_path),
        ]
        temporary_csv, temporary_metrics, temporary_plot = (
            temporary_path for temporary_path, _ in artifact_pairs
        )

        table.to_csv(temporary_csv, float_format="%.3f")
        temporary_metrics.write_text(report_json, encoding="utf-8")
        plot_forecast(table, metrics, temporary_plot)

        for temporary_path, final_path in artifact_pairs:
            os.replace(temporary_path, final_path)

    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    load = load_hourly_series(args.data)
    features = build_feature_frame(load)
    csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics = write_outputs(
        load,
        features,
        args.output_dir,
    )

    print(f"Forecast complete: {FORECAST_HOURS} hourly values")
    print(f"MAPE: {metrics.mape_percent:.3f}%")
    print(f"MAE: {metrics.mae_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"RMSE: {metrics.rmse_mw:,.1f} MW")
    r_squared = "undefined" if metrics.r_squared is None else f"{metrics.r_squared:.4f}"
    print(f"R-squared: {r_squared}")
    print(f"Mean error: {metrics.mean_error_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"Forecast table: {csv_path}")
    print(f"Metrics report: {metrics_path}")
    print(f"Plot: {plot_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

import holidays
import lightgbm
import matplotlib
import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt
import pandas as pd  # type: ignore[import-untyped]
from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor
from matplotlib.axes import Axes
from matplotlib.backends.backend_agg import FigureCanvasAgg
from matplotlib.figure import Figure
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter

TIMESTAMP_COLUMN = "utc_timestamp"
LOAD_COLUMN = "DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency"
FORECAST_START = pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC")
FORECAST_HOURS = 168
FORECAST_END = FORECAST_START + pd.Timedelta(hours=FORECAST_HOURS)
FORECAST_LAST = FORECAST_END - pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
WEEK_HOURS = 168
WEEKLY_LAGS = tuple(WEEK_HOURS * week for week in range(1, 5))
ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS = 4 * WEEK_HOURS
FEATURE_WARMUP_HOURS = max(
    max(WEEKLY_LAGS),
    WEEK_HOURS + ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS,
)
MIN_TRAINING_ROWS = 365 * 24
REQUIRED_HISTORY_HOURS = FEATURE_WARMUP_HOURS + MIN_TRAINING_ROWS - 1
VALIDATION_STARTS = (
    pd.Timestamp("2017-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
    pd.Timestamp("2018-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
    pd.Timestamp("2019-01-01 00:00:00", tz="UTC"),
)
REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS = (*VALIDATION_STARTS, FORECAST_START)
REQUIRED_DATA_START = min(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS) - pd.Timedelta(hours=REQUIRED_HISTORY_HOURS)
REQUIRED_DATA_END = max(REQUIRED_FORECAST_STARTS) + pd.Timedelta(hours=FORECAST_HOURS - 1)

SURFACE = "#fcfcfb"
PRIMARY_TEXT = "#0b0b0b"
SECONDARY_TEXT = "#52514e"
MUTED_TEXT = "#898781"
GRID = "#e1e0d9"
AXIS = "#c3c2b7"
ACTUAL_COLOR = "#2a78d6"
FORECAST_COLOR = "#eb6834"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelParameters:
    n_estimators: int = 400
    learning_rate: float = 0.04
    num_leaves: int = 31
    min_child_samples: int = 60
    reg_lambda: float = 1.0
    random_state: int = 42


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ForecastMetrics:
    mae_mw: float
    rmse_mw: float
    mape_percent: float
    mean_error_mw: float
    r_squared: float | None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelForecast:
    predictions: npt.NDArray[np.float64]
    training_index: pd.DatetimeIndex


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ForecastReport:
    model: str
    model_library: str
    model_library_version: str
    model_parameters: ModelParameters
    feature_timezone: str
    target_start_utc: str
    target_end_utc_exclusive: str
    forecast_hours: int
    training_start_utc: str
    training_end_utc: str
    training_hours: int
    historical_validation_mape_percent_by_start_utc: dict[str, float]
    historical_validation_mean_mape_percent: float
    accuracy: ForecastMetrics
    weekly_naive_baseline: ForecastMetrics
    mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent: float | None


def format_date_range(start: pd.Timestamp, end_inclusive: pd.Timestamp) -> str:
    start_date = start.date()
    end_date = end_inclusive.date()
    if start_date == end_date:
        return f"{start_date.day} {start.strftime('%B %Y')}"
    if (start_date.year, start_date.month) == (end_date.year, end_date.month):
        return f"{start_date.day}-{end_date.day} {start.strftime('%B %Y')}"
    if start_date.year == end_date.year:
        return (
            f"{start_date.day} {start.strftime('%B')}-"
            f"{end_date.day} {end_inclusive.strftime('%B %Y')}"
        )
    return (
        f"{start_date.day} {start.strftime('%B %Y')}-"
        f"{end_date.day} {end_inclusive.strftime('%B %Y')}"
    )


FORECAST_DATE_LABEL = format_date_range(FORECAST_START, FORECAST_LAST)
OUTPUT_STEM = (
    f"german_load_forecast_{FORECAST_START.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
    f"_to_{FORECAST_LAST.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
)
MODEL_PARAMETERS = ModelParameters()


def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            f"Forecast German hourly electricity load for {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} "
            "from earlier observations in the OPSD load dataset."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--data",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).with_name("opsd_de_load.csv"),
        help="Path to opsd_de_load.csv.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).parent,
        help="Directory for the forecast CSV, metrics JSON, and PNG plot.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def forecast_index(start: pd.Timestamp = FORECAST_START) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
    if start.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("Forecast start must be timezone-aware")
    return pd.date_range(start, periods=FORECAST_HOURS, freq="h")


def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
    if missing_columns:
        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
    if frame.empty:
        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")

    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
    load = load.sort_index()

    if load.index.has_duplicates:
        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
    if missing_values:
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
        )
    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
        )

    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
    index = load.index
    off_grid = (
        (index.minute != 0)
        | (index.second != 0)
        | (index.microsecond != 0)
        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
    )
    if off_grid.any():
        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")

    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
    if not index.equals(expected):
        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
        raise ValueError(
            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
        )

    return load


def date_membership(
    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
    members: set[date],
) -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
    return np.asarray(pd.Index(local_dates).isin(members), dtype=np.float64)


def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
    days_before_holidays = {
        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
    }
    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
    reduced_load_days = {
        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
    }

    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
    features["hour"] = hour
    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
        local_dates,
        days_before_holidays,
    )
    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
        local_dates,
        days_after_holidays,
    )
    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)

    harmonic_groups = (
        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
    )
    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)

    return features


def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
    lag_names: list[str] = []
    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
        name = f"lag_{lag}"
        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
        lag_names.append(name)

    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
    )
    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
    )
    return features


def make_model() -> LGBMRegressor:
    return LGBMRegressor(
        n_estimators=MODEL_PARAMETERS.n_estimators,
        learning_rate=MODEL_PARAMETERS.learning_rate,
        num_leaves=MODEL_PARAMETERS.num_leaves,
        min_child_samples=MODEL_PARAMETERS.min_child_samples,
        reg_lambda=MODEL_PARAMETERS.reg_lambda,
        random_state=MODEL_PARAMETERS.random_state,
        verbosity=-1,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )


def complete_training_rows(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    before: pd.Timestamp,
) -> pd.Series:
    return (features.index < before) & features.notna().all(axis=1)


def train_and_predict(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    start: pd.Timestamp,
) -> ModelForecast:
    target = forecast_index(start)
    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")

    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
        )

    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
    if target_features.isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")

    model = make_model()
    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
    return ModelForecast(
        predictions=predictions,
        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
    )


def calculate_metrics(
    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
) -> ForecastMetrics:
    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
    if actual_values.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")

    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
    return ForecastMetrics(
        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
        r_squared=r_squared,
    )


def relative_mape_improvement(
    model_mape: float,
    baseline_mape: float,
) -> float | None:
    if baseline_mape == 0:
        return None
    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100


def run_historical_validation(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:
        forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, start)
        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
        fold_scores[start.isoformat()] = metrics.mape_percent
    return fold_scores


def build_forecast_table(
    target: pd.DatetimeIndex,
    actual: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
    predicted: npt.NDArray[np.float64],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    errors = predicted - actual
    table = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "actual_load_mw": actual,
            "forecast_load_mw": predicted,
            "error_mw": errors,
            "absolute_percentage_error_percent": np.abs(errors / actual) * 100,
        },
        index=target,
    )
    table.index.name = TIMESTAMP_COLUMN
    return table


def format_megawatt_tick(value: float, _: float) -> str:
    if abs(value) >= 10_000:
        return f"{value / 1_000:.0f}k"
    if abs(value) >= 1_000:
        return f"{value / 1_000:.1f}k"
    return f"{value:,.0f}"


def style_axis(axis: Axes) -> None:
    axis.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
    axis.tick_params(colors=MUTED_TEXT, labelsize=9, length=0)
    axis.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, linewidth=0.8)
    axis.set_axisbelow(True)
    axis.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    axis.spines["left"].set_color(AXIS)
    axis.spines["bottom"].set_color(AXIS)
    axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(format_megawatt_tick))


def plot_forecast(
    table: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: ForecastMetrics,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    plot_style: dict[str, object] = {
        "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
        "text.color": PRIMARY_TEXT,
        "axes.labelcolor": SECONDARY_TEXT,
        "axes.titlecolor": PRIMARY_TEXT,
    }
    with matplotlib.rc_context(plot_style):
        figure = Figure(figsize=(14, 8), facecolor=SURFACE)
        FigureCanvasAgg(figure)
        load_axis, error_axis = figure.subplots(
            2,
            1,
            sharex=True,
            gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": (3.2, 1), "hspace": 0.08},
        )
        index = table.index
        actual = table["actual_load_mw"]
        predicted = table["forecast_load_mw"]
        errors = table["error_mw"]

        load_axis.plot(
            index,
            actual,
            color=ACTUAL_COLOR,
            linewidth=2,
            solid_capstyle="round",
            label="Actual load",
        )
        load_axis.plot(
            index,
            predicted,
            color=FORECAST_COLOR,
            linewidth=2,
            linestyle=(0, (4, 2)),
            dash_capstyle="round",
            label="Forecast load",
        )
        load_axis.fill_between(
            index,
            actual,
            predicted,
            color=FORECAST_COLOR,
            alpha=0.08,
            linewidth=0,
        )
        load_axis.set_ylabel("Load (MW)")
        load_axis.legend(
            loc="upper left",
            ncols=2,
            frameon=False,
            fontsize=10,
            labelcolor=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        )

        error_axis.plot(
            index,
            errors,
            color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
            linewidth=1.5,
            solid_capstyle="round",
        )
        error_axis.fill_between(
            index,
            0,
            errors,
            color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
            alpha=0.12,
            linewidth=0,
        )
        error_axis.axhline(0, color=AXIS, linewidth=1)
        error_axis.set_ylabel("Error\n(MW)")
        error_limit = max(1_000.0, float(np.max(np.abs(errors))) * 1.15)
        error_axis.set_ylim(-error_limit, error_limit)
        error_axis.set_xlim(index[0], index[-1])
        daily_ticks = pd.date_range(index[0].floor("D"), index[-1], freq="D")
        error_axis.set_xticks(daily_ticks.to_pydatetime())
        error_axis.set_xticklabels([timestamp.strftime("%a\n%d %b") for timestamp in daily_ticks])
        error_axis.set_xlabel("Timestamp (UTC)")

        for axis in (load_axis, error_axis):
            style_axis(axis)

        figure.suptitle(
            "German electricity load: actual vs forecast",
            x=0.075,
            y=0.975,
            ha="left",
            fontsize=18,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=PRIMARY_TEXT,
        )
        figure.text(
            0.975,
            0.967,
            (
                f"MAPE {metrics.mape_percent:.2f}%   "
                f"MAE {metrics.mae_mw:,.0f} MW   "
                f"RMSE {metrics.rmse_mw:,.0f} MW"
            ),
            ha="right",
            va="top",
            fontsize=10,
            color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        )
        figure.text(
            0.075,
            0.935,
            (
                f"{FORECAST_HOURS} hourly observations, {FORECAST_DATE_LABEL} | "
                "Shaded area shows forecast error"
            ),
            ha="left",
            va="top",
            fontsize=10,
            color=SECONDARY_TEXT,
        )
        figure.subplots_adjust(left=0.075, right=0.975, bottom=0.105, top=0.89)
        figure.savefig(output_path, dpi=180, facecolor=SURFACE)


def write_outputs(
    load: pd.Series,
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
    forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, FORECAST_START)
    target = forecast_index()
    actual = np.asarray(load.loc[target].to_numpy(), dtype=np.float64)
    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
    weekly_naive = np.asarray(
        features.loc[target, f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"].to_numpy(),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
    )
    training_index = forecast.training_index

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"
    table = build_forecast_table(target, actual, forecast.predictions)

    report = ForecastReport(
        model=type(make_model()).__name__,
        model_library="lightgbm",
        model_library_version=lightgbm.__version__,
        model_parameters=MODEL_PARAMETERS,
        feature_timezone="Europe/Berlin",
        target_start_utc=FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
        target_end_utc_exclusive=FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
        forecast_hours=FORECAST_HOURS,
        training_start_utc=training_index[0].isoformat(),
        training_end_utc=training_index[-1].isoformat(),
        training_hours=len(training_index),
        historical_validation_mape_percent_by_start_utc=validation_scores,
        historical_validation_mean_mape_percent=float(np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))),
        accuracy=metrics,
        weekly_naive_baseline=weekly_naive_metrics,
        mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent=mape_improvement,
    )
    report_json = json.dumps(asdict(report), indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n"

    with TemporaryDirectory(dir=output_dir, prefix=f".{OUTPUT_STEM}-") as temporary:
        temporary_dir = Path(temporary)
        artifact_pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path]] = [
            (temporary_dir / csv_path.name, csv_path),
            (temporary_dir / metrics_path.name, metrics_path),
            (temporary_dir / plot_path.name, plot_path),
        ]
        temporary_csv, temporary_metrics, temporary_plot = (
            temporary_path for temporary_path, _ in artifact_pairs
        )

        table.to_csv(temporary_csv, float_format="%.3f")
        temporary_metrics.write_text(report_json, encoding="utf-8")
        plot_forecast(table, metrics, temporary_plot)

        for temporary_path, final_path in artifact_pairs:
            os.replace(temporary_path, final_path)

    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    load = load_hourly_series(args.data)
    features = build_feature_frame(load)
    csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics = write_outputs(
        load,
        features,
        args.output_dir,
    )

    print(f"Forecast complete: {FORECAST_HOURS} hourly values")
    print(f"MAPE: {metrics.mape_percent:.3f}%")
    print(f"MAE: {metrics.mae_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"RMSE: {metrics.rmse_mw:,.1f} MW")
    r_squared = "undefined" if metrics.r_squared is None else f"{metrics.r_squared:.4f}"
    print(f"R-squared: {r_squared}")
    print(f"Mean error: {metrics.mean_error_mw:,.1f} MW")
    print(f"Forecast table: {csv_path}")
    print(f"Metrics report: {metrics_path}")
    print(f"Plot: {plot_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

213	def date_membership(
214	    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
215	    members: set[date],
216	) -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
217	    return np.asarray(pd.Index(local_dates).isin(members), dtype=np.float64)

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features
269

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
341	    )

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )
373

375	def relative_mape_improvement(
376	    model_mape: float,
377	    baseline_mape: float,
378	) -> float | None:
379	    if baseline_mape == 0:
380	        return None
381	    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100

384	def run_historical_validation(
385	    load: pd.Series,
386	    features: pd.DataFrame,
387	) -> dict[str, float]:
388	    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
389	    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:
390	        forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, start)
391	        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
392	        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
393	        fold_scores[start.isoformat()] = metrics.mape_percent
394	    return fold_scores

561	def write_outputs(
562	    load: pd.Series,
563	    features: pd.DataFrame,
564	    output_dir: Path,
565	) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
566	    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
567	    forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, FORECAST_START)
568	    target = forecast_index()
569	    actual = np.asarray(load.loc[target].to_numpy(), dtype=np.float64)
570	    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
571	    weekly_naive = np.asarray(
572	        features.loc[target, f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"].to_numpy(),
573	        dtype=np.float64,
574	    )
575	    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
576	    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
577	        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
578	        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
579	    )
580	    training_index = forecast.training_index
581	
582	    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

586	    table = build_forecast_table(target, actual, forecast.predictions)
587	
588	    report = ForecastReport(

591	        model_library_version=lightgbm.__version__,
592	        model_parameters=MODEL_PARAMETERS,

596	        forecast_hours=FORECAST_HOURS,

612	            (temporary_dir / metrics_path.name, metrics_path),

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

213	def date_membership(
214	    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
215	    members: set[date],
216	) -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
217	    return np.asarray(pd.Index(local_dates).isin(members), dtype=np.float64)

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features
269

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
341	    )

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

375	def relative_mape_improvement(
376	    model_mape: float,
377	    baseline_mape: float,
378	) -> float | None:
379	    if baseline_mape == 0:
380	        return None
381	    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100

561	def write_outputs(
562	    load: pd.Series,
563	    features: pd.DataFrame,
564	    output_dir: Path,
565	) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
566	    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
567	    forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, FORECAST_START)
568	    target = forecast_index()
569	    actual = np.asarray(load.loc[target].to_numpy(), dtype=np.float64)
570	    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
571	    weekly_naive = np.asarray(
572	        features.loc[target, f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"].to_numpy(),
573	        dtype=np.float64,
574	    )
575	    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
576	    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
577	        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
578	        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
579	    )
580	    training_index = forecast.training_index
581	
582	    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
583	    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
584	    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
585	    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"
586	    table = build_forecast_table(target, actual, forecast.predictions)
587	
588	    report = ForecastReport(
589	        model=type(make_model()).__name__,
590	        model_library="lightgbm",
591	        model_library_version=lightgbm.__version__,
592	        model_parameters=MODEL_PARAMETERS,
593	        feature_timezone="Europe/Berlin",
594	        target_start_utc=FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
595	        target_end_utc_exclusive=FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
596	        forecast_hours=FORECAST_HOURS,
597	        training_start_utc=training_index[0].isoformat(),
598	        training_end_utc=training_index[-1].isoformat(),
599	        training_hours=len(training_index),
600	        historical_validation_mape_percent_by_start_utc=validation_scores,
601	        historical_validation_mean_mape_percent=float(np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))),
602	        accuracy=metrics,
603	        weekly_naive_baseline=weekly_naive_metrics,
604	        mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent=mape_improvement,
605	    )
606	    report_json = json.dumps(asdict(report), indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
607	
608	    with TemporaryDirectory(dir=output_dir, prefix=f".{OUTPUT_STEM}-") as temporary:
609	        temporary_dir = Path(temporary)
610	        artifact_pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path]] = [
611	            (temporary_dir / csv_path.name, csv_path),
612	            (temporary_dir / metrics_path.name, metrics_path),
613	            (temporary_dir / plot_path.name, plot_path),
614	        ]
615	        temporary_csv, temporary_metrics, temporary_plot = (
616	            temporary_path for temporary_path, _ in artifact_pairs
617	        )
618	
619	        table.to_csv(temporary_csv, float_format="%.3f")
620	        temporary_metrics.write_text(report_json, encoding="utf-8")
621	        plot_forecast(table, metrics, temporary_plot)
622	
623	        for temporary_path, final_path in artifact_pairs:
624	            os.replace(temporary_path, final_path)
625	
626	    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
341	    )

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

375	def relative_mape_improvement(
376	    model_mape: float,
377	    baseline_mape: float,
378	) -> float | None:
379	    if baseline_mape == 0:
380	        return None
381	    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100

384	def run_historical_validation(
385	    load: pd.Series,
386	    features: pd.DataFrame,
387	) -> dict[str, float]:
388	    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
389	    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:
390	        forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, start)
391	        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
392	        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
393	        fold_scores[start.isoformat()] = metrics.mape_percent
394	    return fold_scores

561	def write_outputs(
562	    load: pd.Series,
563	    features: pd.DataFrame,
564	    output_dir: Path,
565	) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
566	    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
567	    forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, FORECAST_START)
568	    target = forecast_index()
569	    actual = np.asarray(load.loc[target].to_numpy(), dtype=np.float64)
570	    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
571	    weekly_naive = np.asarray(
572	        features.loc[target, f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"].to_numpy(),
573	        dtype=np.float64,
574	    )
575	    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
576	    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
577	        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
578	        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
579	    )
580	    training_index = forecast.training_index
581	
582	    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
583	    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
584	    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
585	    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"
586	    table = build_forecast_table(target, actual, forecast.predictions)
587	
588	    report = ForecastReport(
589	        model=type(make_model()).__name__,
590	        model_library="lightgbm",
591	        model_library_version=lightgbm.__version__,
592	        model_parameters=MODEL_PARAMETERS,
593	        feature_timezone="Europe/Berlin",
594	        target_start_utc=FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
595	        target_end_utc_exclusive=FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
596	        forecast_hours=FORECAST_HOURS,
597	        training_start_utc=training_index[0].isoformat(),
598	        training_end_utc=training_index[-1].isoformat(),
599	        training_hours=len(training_index),
600	        historical_validation_mape_percent_by_start_utc=validation_scores,
601	        historical_validation_mean_mape_percent=float(np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))),
602	        accuracy=metrics,
603	        weekly_naive_baseline=weekly_naive_metrics,
604	        mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent=mape_improvement,
605	    )
606	    report_json = json.dumps(asdict(report), indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
607	
608	    with TemporaryDirectory(dir=output_dir, prefix=f".{OUTPUT_STEM}-") as temporary:
609	        temporary_dir = Path(temporary)
610	        artifact_pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path]] = [
611	            (temporary_dir / csv_path.name, csv_path),
612	            (temporary_dir / metrics_path.name, metrics_path),
613	            (temporary_dir / plot_path.name, plot_path),
614	        ]
615	        temporary_csv, temporary_metrics, temporary_plot = (
616	            temporary_path for temporary_path, _ in artifact_pairs
617	        )
618	
619	        table.to_csv(temporary_csv, float_format="%.3f")
620	        temporary_metrics.write_text(report_json, encoding="utf-8")
621	        plot_forecast(table, metrics, temporary_plot)
622	
623	        for temporary_path, final_path in artifact_pairs:
624	            os.replace(temporary_path, final_path)
625	
626	    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics
