344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

377	    baseline_mape: float,
378	) -> float | None:
379	    if baseline_mape == 0:

381	    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100

576	    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(

581

272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
341	    )

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

375	def relative_mape_improvement(
376	    model_mape: float,
377	    baseline_mape: float,
378	) -> float | None:
379	    if baseline_mape == 0:
380	        return None
381	    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100

385	    load: pd.Series,

389	    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:

392	        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
393	        fold_scores[start.isoformat()] = metrics.mape_percent
394	    return fold_scores

158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)

160	    if missing_columns:

162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165

167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(

369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),

221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")

224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }

316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )

330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")

334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features

277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

214	    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
215	    members: set[date],
216	) -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
217	    return np.asarray(pd.Index(local_dates).isin(members), dtype=np.float64)

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features
269

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

305	def complete_training_rows(
306	    features: pd.DataFrame,

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
341	    )

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

375	def relative_mape_improvement(
376	    model_mape: float,
377	    baseline_mape: float,
378	) -> float | None:
379	    if baseline_mape == 0:
380	        return None
381	    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100

384	def run_historical_validation(
385	    load: pd.Series,
386	    features: pd.DataFrame,
387	) -> dict[str, float]:
388	    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
389	    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:

392	        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
393	        fold_scores[start.isoformat()] = metrics.mape_percent
394	    return fold_scores

567	    forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, FORECAST_START)
568	    target = forecast_index()
569	    actual = np.asarray(load.loc[target].to_numpy(), dtype=np.float64)
570	    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
571	    weekly_naive = np.asarray(
572	        features.loc[target, f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"].to_numpy(),
573	        dtype=np.float64,
574	    )
575	    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
576	    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
577	        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
578	        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
579	    )
580	    training_index = forecast.training_index
581	
582	    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
583	    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
584	    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
585	    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"
586	    table = build_forecast_table(target, actual, forecast.predictions)
587	
588	    report = ForecastReport(
589	        model=type(make_model()).__name__,
590	        model_library="lightgbm",
591	        model_library_version=lightgbm.__version__,
592	        model_parameters=MODEL_PARAMETERS,
593	        feature_timezone="Europe/Berlin",
594	        target_start_utc=FORECAST_START.isoformat(),
595	        target_end_utc_exclusive=FORECAST_END.isoformat(),
596	        forecast_hours=FORECAST_HOURS,
597	        training_start_utc=training_index[0].isoformat(),
598	        training_end_utc=training_index[-1].isoformat(),
599	        training_hours=len(training_index),
600	        historical_validation_mape_percent_by_start_utc=validation_scores,
601	        historical_validation_mean_mape_percent=float(np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))),
602	        accuracy=metrics,
603	        weekly_naive_baseline=weekly_naive_metrics,
604	        mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent=mape_improvement,
605	    )
606	    report_json = json.dumps(asdict(report), indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
607	
608	    with TemporaryDirectory(dir=output_dir, prefix=f".{OUTPUT_STEM}-") as temporary:
609	        temporary_dir = Path(temporary)
610	        artifact_pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path]] = [
611	            (temporary_dir / csv_path.name, csv_path),
612	            (temporary_dir / metrics_path.name, metrics_path),
613	            (temporary_dir / plot_path.name, plot_path),
614	        ]
615	        temporary_csv, temporary_metrics, temporary_plot = (
616	            temporary_path for temporary_path, _ in artifact_pairs
617	        )
618	
619	        table.to_csv(temporary_csv, float_format="%.3f")
620	        temporary_metrics.write_text(report_json, encoding="utf-8")
621	        plot_forecast(table, metrics, temporary_plot)
622	
623	        for temporary_path, final_path in artifact_pairs:
624	            os.replace(temporary_path, final_path)
625	
626	    return csv_path, metrics_path, plot_path, metrics

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

213	def date_membership(
214	    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
215	    members: set[date],
216	) -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
217	    return np.asarray(pd.Index(local_dates).isin(members), dtype=np.float64)

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features
269

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
341	    )

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

375	def relative_mape_improvement(
376	    model_mape: float,
377	    baseline_mape: float,
378	) -> float | None:
379	    if baseline_mape == 0:
380	        return None
381	    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100

384	def run_historical_validation(
385	    load: pd.Series,
386	    features: pd.DataFrame,
387	) -> dict[str, float]:
388	    fold_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
389	    for start in VALIDATION_STARTS:

391	        actual = load.loc[forecast_index(start)].to_numpy()
392	        metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
393	        fold_scores[start.isoformat()] = metrics.mape_percent
394	    return fold_scores

565	) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
566	    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
567	    forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, FORECAST_START)
568	    target = forecast_index()
569	    actual = np.asarray(load.loc[target].to_numpy(), dtype=np.float64)
570	    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
571	    weekly_naive = np.asarray(

573	        dtype=np.float64,
574	    )
575	    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
576	    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
577	        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
578	        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
579	    )
580	    training_index = forecast.training_index
581	
582	    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
583	    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
584	    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
585	    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"

347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)

351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")

362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")

364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []

276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()

285	    )

287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
341	    )

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

213	def date_membership(
214	    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
215	    members: set[date],
216	) -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
217	    return np.asarray(pd.Index(local_dates).isin(members), dtype=np.float64)

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features
269

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

312	def train_and_predict(
313	    load: pd.Series,
314	    features: pd.DataFrame,
315	    start: pd.Timestamp,
316	) -> ModelForecast:
317	    target = forecast_index(start)
318	    if not target.isin(features.index).all():
319	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset does not cover forecast horizon beginning {start}")
320	
321	    train_rows = complete_training_rows(features, start)
322	    training_count = int(train_rows.sum())
323	    if training_count < MIN_TRAINING_ROWS:
324	        raise ValueError(
325	            f"At least {MIN_TRAINING_ROWS} complete training rows are required before "
326	            f"{start.isoformat()}; found {training_count}"
327	        )
328	
329	    history_only = load.mask(load.index >= start)
330	    target_features = build_feature_frame(history_only).loc[target]
331	    if target_features.isna().any().any():
332	        raise ValueError(f"Target features contain missing values for horizon {start}")
333	
334	    model = make_model()
335	    model.fit(features.loc[train_rows], load.loc[train_rows])
336	    predictions = np.asarray(model.predict(target_features), dtype=np.float64)
337	    predictions = np.round(predictions, decimals=3)
338	    return ModelForecast(
339	        predictions=predictions,
340	        training_index=features.index[train_rows],
341	    )

344	def calculate_metrics(
345	    actual: npt.ArrayLike,
346	    predicted: npt.ArrayLike,
347	) -> ForecastMetrics:
348	    actual_values = np.asarray(actual, dtype=float)
349	    predicted_values = np.asarray(predicted, dtype=float)
350	    if actual_values.shape != predicted_values.shape:
351	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must have the same shape")
352	    if actual_values.size == 0:
353	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted arrays must not be empty")
354	    if not np.isfinite(actual_values).all() or not np.isfinite(predicted_values).all():
355	        raise ValueError("Actual and predicted values must be finite")
356	    if np.any(actual_values == 0):
357	        raise ValueError("MAPE is undefined when an actual value is zero")
358	
359	    errors = predicted_values - actual_values
360	    percentage_errors = np.abs(errors / actual_values)
361	    if not np.isfinite(percentage_errors).all():
362	        raise ValueError("Percentage errors must be finite")
363	    residual_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(errors)))
364	    total_sum = float(np.sum(np.square(actual_values - actual_values.mean())))
365	    r_squared = 1.0 - residual_sum / total_sum if total_sum else None
366	    return ForecastMetrics(
367	        mae_mw=float(np.mean(np.abs(errors))),
368	        rmse_mw=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors)))),
369	        mape_percent=float(np.mean(percentage_errors) * 100),
370	        mean_error_mw=float(np.mean(errors)),
371	        r_squared=r_squared,
372	    )

375	def relative_mape_improvement(
376	    model_mape: float,
377	    baseline_mape: float,
378	) -> float | None:
379	    if baseline_mape == 0:
380	        return None
381	    return (baseline_mape - model_mape) / baseline_mape * 100

561	def write_outputs(
562	    load: pd.Series,
563	    features: pd.DataFrame,
564	    output_dir: Path,
565	) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, ForecastMetrics]:
566	    validation_scores = run_historical_validation(load, features)
567	    forecast = train_and_predict(load, features, FORECAST_START)
568	    target = forecast_index()
569	    actual = np.asarray(load.loc[target].to_numpy(), dtype=np.float64)
570	    metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, forecast.predictions)
571	    weekly_naive = np.asarray(
572	        features.loc[target, f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"].to_numpy(),
573	        dtype=np.float64,
574	    )
575	    weekly_naive_metrics = calculate_metrics(actual, weekly_naive)
576	    mape_improvement = relative_mape_improvement(
577	        model_mape=metrics.mape_percent,
578	        baseline_mape=weekly_naive_metrics.mape_percent,
579	    )
580	    training_index = forecast.training_index
581	
582	    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
583	    csv_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.csv"
584	    metrics_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}_metrics.json"
585	    plot_path = output_dir / f"{OUTPUT_STEM}.png"
586	    table = build_forecast_table(target, actual, forecast.predictions)
587

599	        training_hours=len(training_index),
600	        historical_validation_mape_percent_by_start_utc=validation_scores,
601	        historical_validation_mean_mape_percent=float(np.mean(list(validation_scores.values()))),
602	        accuracy=metrics,
603	        weekly_naive_baseline=weekly_naive_metrics,
604	        mape_improvement_over_weekly_naive_percent=mape_improvement,
605	    )
606	    report_json = json.dumps(asdict(report), indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
607	
608	    with TemporaryDirectory(dir=output_dir, prefix=f".{OUTPUT_STEM}-") as temporary:
609	        temporary_dir = Path(temporary)
610	        artifact_pairs: list[tuple[Path, Path]] = [
611	            (temporary_dir / csv_path.name, csv_path),
612	            (temporary_dir / metrics_path.name, metrics_path),
613	            (temporary_dir / plot_path.name, plot_path),

622	
623	        for temporary_path, final_path in artifact_pairs:
624	            os.replace(temporary_path, final_path)

157	def load_hourly_series(path: Path) -> pd.Series:
158	    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
159	    missing_columns = {TIMESTAMP_COLUMN, LOAD_COLUMN}.difference(frame.columns)
160	    if missing_columns:
161	        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
162	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset is missing required columns: {names}")
163	    if frame.empty:
164	        raise ValueError("Dataset is empty")
165	
166	    timestamps = pd.to_datetime(frame[TIMESTAMP_COLUMN], utc=True, errors="raise")
167	    values = pd.to_numeric(frame[LOAD_COLUMN], errors="raise")
168	    load = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(dtype=float), index=timestamps, name=LOAD_COLUMN)
169	    load = load.sort_index()
170	
171	    if load.index.has_duplicates:
172	        duplicates = int(load.index.duplicated().sum())
173	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {duplicates} duplicate timestamps")
174	    missing_values = int(load.isna().sum())
175	    if missing_values:
176	        raise ValueError(f"Dataset contains {missing_values} missing load values")
177	    if not np.isfinite(load.to_numpy()).all() or (load <= 0).any():
178	        raise ValueError("Load values must be finite and strictly positive")
179	    if load.index[0] > REQUIRED_DATA_START:
180	        raise ValueError(
181	            "Dataset does not contain enough history for validation and training; "
182	            f"it must begin by {REQUIRED_DATA_START.isoformat()}"
183	        )
184	    if load.index[-1] < REQUIRED_DATA_END:
185	        raise ValueError(
186	            "Dataset does not cover every validation and forecast horizon; "
187	            f"it must continue through {REQUIRED_DATA_END.isoformat()}"
188	        )
189	
190	    load = load.loc[:REQUIRED_DATA_END]
191	    index = load.index
192	    off_grid = (
193	        (index.minute != 0)
194	        | (index.second != 0)
195	        | (index.microsecond != 0)
196	        | (index.nanosecond != 0)
197	    )
198	    if off_grid.any():
199	        raise ValueError("Timestamps must fall exactly on UTC hour boundaries")
200	
201	    expected = pd.date_range(index[0], index[-1], freq="h", tz="UTC")
202	    if not index.equals(expected):
203	        missing_hours = len(expected.difference(index))
204	        extra_hours = len(index.difference(expected))
205	        raise ValueError(
206	            "Dataset is not continuous hourly data; "
207	            f"{missing_hours} hours missing and {extra_hours} off-grid hours present"
208	        )
209	
210	    return load

213	def date_membership(
214	    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
215	    members: set[date],
216	) -> npt.NDArray[np.float64]:
217	    return np.asarray(pd.Index(local_dates).isin(members), dtype=np.float64)

220	def build_calendar_features(index: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> pd.DataFrame:
221	    local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Berlin")
222	    local_dates = np.asarray(local.date, dtype=object)
223	    holiday_years = list(range(int(local.year.min()) - 1, int(local.year.max()) + 2))
224	    public_holidays = set(holidays.country_holidays("DE", years=holiday_years).keys())
225	    days_before_holidays = {
226	        public_holiday - timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays
227	    }
228	    days_after_holidays = {public_holiday + timedelta(days=1) for public_holiday in public_holidays}
229	    reduced_load_days = {
230	        date(year, month, day) for year in holiday_years for month, day in ((12, 24), (12, 31))
231	    }
232	
233	    hour = local.hour.to_numpy(dtype=float)
234	    day_of_week = local.dayofweek.to_numpy(dtype=float)
235	    day_of_year = local.dayofyear.to_numpy(dtype=float)
236	    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
237	    features["hour"] = hour
238	    features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
239	    features["month"] = local.month.to_numpy(dtype=float)
240	    features["day_of_month"] = local.day.to_numpy(dtype=float)
241	    features["day_of_year"] = day_of_year
242	    features["trend_years"] = (index - index[0]).total_seconds().to_numpy() / (
243	        365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60
244	    )
245	    features["is_weekend"] = (day_of_week >= 5).astype(float)
246	    features["is_public_holiday"] = date_membership(local_dates, public_holidays)
247	    features["is_day_before_holiday"] = date_membership(
248	        local_dates,
249	        days_before_holidays,
250	    )
251	    features["is_day_after_holiday"] = date_membership(
252	        local_dates,
253	        days_after_holidays,
254	    )
255	    features["is_reduced_load_day"] = date_membership(local_dates, reduced_load_days)
256	
257	    harmonic_groups = (
258	        ("hour", hour, 24.0, 3),
259	        ("week", day_of_week, 7.0, 2),
260	        ("year", day_of_year, 365.25, 4),
261	    )
262	    for prefix, values, period, harmonics in harmonic_groups:
263	        for harmonic in range(1, harmonics + 1):
264	            angle = 2 * np.pi * harmonic * values / period
265	            features[f"{prefix}_sin_{harmonic}"] = np.sin(angle)
266	            features[f"{prefix}_cos_{harmonic}"] = np.cos(angle)
267	
268	    return features

271	def build_feature_frame(load: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
272	    features = build_calendar_features(load.index)
273	    lag_names: list[str] = []
274	    for lag in WEEKLY_LAGS:
275	        name = f"lag_{lag}"
276	        features[name] = load.shift(lag)
277	        lag_names.append(name)
278	
279	    features["weekly_lag_mean"] = features[lag_names].mean(axis=1)
280	    features["weekly_lag_median"] = features[lag_names].median(axis=1)
281	    features["weekly_lag_std"] = features[lag_names].std(axis=1)
282	    features["previous_week_mean"] = load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(WEEK_HOURS).mean()
283	    features["recent_four_week_mean"] = (
284	        load.shift(WEEK_HOURS).rolling(ROLLING_FEATURE_WINDOW_HOURS).mean()
285	    )
286	    features["lag_change_one_week"] = (
287	        features[f"lag_{WEEK_HOURS}"] - features[f"lag_{2 * WEEK_HOURS}"]
288	    )
289	    return features

214	    local_dates: npt.NDArray[np.object_],
